empty: No commands configured. Add some in Settings → Plugins.
hint: Each row uses its entry in “Layouts”; if missing, the fallback geometry is used. Edit everything with the gear button.
overlap_tooltip: When launching, a window that would collide with an open one moves to the closest free spot.

close_on_launch.description: Close the panel as soon as a terminal is launched.
close_on_launch.label: Close panel after launch

commands.description: Name = shell command. Each entry becomes a button in the panel.
commands.label: Commands

fonts.description: Optional kitty font per command: "Family, size". E.g.: lyrics = Departure Mono, 22. Only applies when the terminal is kitty; the font must be installed.
fonts.label: Per-command font

height.description: Height for commands without a Layouts entry.
height.label: Fallback height

layouts.description: One entry per command: anchor, size and optional offset. E.g.: cava = bottom-center, 1610x584; lavat = bottom-left, 802x582; unimatrix = right-center, 869x1424. Anchors: any combination of top, left, center, right and bottom. Use custom, WxH, x, y for absolute monitor coordinates.
layouts.label: Per-command layouts

margin.description: Pixel margin from the monitor edges for anchored layouts.
margin.label: Margin

output.description: Monitor connector where windows should open (e.g. DP-1). Empty = focused monitor.
output.label: Monitor

reuse_existing.description: If the command's window is already open, focus it and reapply its geometry instead of opening another one.
reuse_existing.label: Reuse open window

width.description: Width for commands without a Layouts entry.
width.label: Fallback width

x.description: Fallback horizontal position (monitor coordinates) for commands without Layouts.
x.label: Fallback X position

y.description: Fallback vertical position (monitor coordinates) for commands without Layouts.
y.label: Fallback Y position

subtitle: {terminal} · {margin} px margin · {output}
